steps.text: ...One hundred and eighty-sixth day since making it back to Londinium.
Three more men joined us today. Two of them are seriously hurt. Only Robben is still able to fight.
In just this area, there are still at least seventy men in the enemy's hands.
With all of Londinium fallen, there is no telling how many soldiers have been captured.
I don't know whether they are still alive.
And I certainly don't know whether I should hope they are still alive.

Every day, someone who fought so hard to live leaves us forever. I try to remember the names of each and every one of them, but the truth is that by the time I meet these men, most of them can no longer speak.
I wish even just one more pair of ears could've heard their voices, and I wish... there could be someone here to hear my voice...
I hope you will one day see these records.
I hope your mission outside is successful.
I hope you won't be back in Londinium so soon...

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Horn, we've got the new hands settled in.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Thanks, Blake. Don't give them any missions just yet. Let them rest a couple of days.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Horn, I don't need time to settle in! I can go out there and fight whenever!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Fine... Blake, assign Robben to 4th. He'll join the next shift as a scout.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Roger that, Horn. Perfect timing. Dublinn activity has been on the rise. We needed more men.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The 3rd still isn't back. Robben, you should stay here and get some rest.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: I can do something else...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I suggest you come over here and sit down. We have half an hour at most. Don't waste it.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: And I understand how you feel.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: You want to go out there and fight, right? The battle this morning wasn't enough to sate your hunger.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Right, my hand is still trembling! It wants me to hold my crossbow a while longer!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Robben, remember one thing.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We are here not because we have to kill a few more Dublinn soldiers or Sarkaz.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Our top priority is to survive.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: After that... it's to make sure as many of us survive as possible.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Horn... I...

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: I understand.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Good. Now get some rest.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: What is that you're holding?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: A notepad.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It's just some random scribblings. Pay it no mind.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: You mentioned that you worked alone for a very long time.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: No wonder you have that kind of habit...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Haha... maybe it's because I've been a captain for too long.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: It felt like something was missing when I had no one to give orders to.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Thankfully, Blake and the lads stole this pen from the Dublinn forces. Otherwise I'd have to carve everything out letter by letter in the sewers.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Have you really done that before?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Go take a look at the sewers all the way at the edge of the city. You might just find my magnum opus, 'Victoria, a Brief History,' personally carved by my own hand.

steps.name: Robben
steps.text: Uh... How long did that take you?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'm just pulling your leg.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Let's save the chit-chat for another time. Dublinn could be here any moment. I'll get some sleep. You should too.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General, Dublinn's Feline Caster is here. She wants to see you.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Is she alone?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Yes, she didn't bring anyone else.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Let her through.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General, her Arts are hard to defend against...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: So it's your opinion that I can't handle her Originium Arts?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: No, that is absolutely not what I meant! General, just like General Theresis, you have my utmost respect as a warrior!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Then go back to where you belong.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Yes, General!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Hoederer, stay here.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I'm sure you are already prepared, having met with the Confessarius's Messenger. I have a job for you.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You want me to find the people from the ship?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You worked with them before.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I'm a mercenary. Mercenaries never remember who we work with. Not unless their heads are worth a lot.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Surely it must be easily to deal with old friends, no?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Maybe...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The Babel assassin has already made it to the city center. It's the Confessarii's job to fend her off.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: As for the others... Hoederer, why don't you take a guess who they have?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The mercenaries in the city still haven't found any traces of any one of them.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: They will make their move sooner or later.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: For the past six months, our eyes in Victoria have been keeping a close eye on that ship. Yet they were always one step ahead of us, to the point that they came all the way to Londinium without any of us noticing.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Why do you think that's the case?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: There's only one possibility. There's someone working for them in Londinium.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Someone working for them... an agent.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: They must have planted this sleeper agent years ago, and this agent must be of some standing too. Otherwise, there is no way they could've escaped our watchful eyes.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Makes sense. My impression is that the Dame Doctor's methods can be... unorthodox.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Hoederer, look into the backgrounds of all the rebels we captured recently.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You think we've already caught them?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: There must be a reason why the Rhodes Islanders are still loitering nearby.
1:15 P.M. \ Overcast
Underground structure, Sudean Borough, Londinium

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Here we are.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Old Bill, it's me. I'm back.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: It's you, huh, lad? I just saw Rockrock. I thought you two left on a mission together.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Uh, she came back first since she had something to take care of.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Who are these folks you have with you... Wait, Sarkaz?!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: D-Do-Don't!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: It's very likely they're the ones the commander's been waiting for!

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: I thought she's waiting for allies? There's no way they could be a bunch of devils!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Bill, give me a break. Where's the commander? I'll see her right now.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Think about it. Do you really think there's a chance I could be a traitor?

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Not one bit. Everyone here treats you like you're their own baby brother.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock had you guard this place, right? Bring a few more men. You can escort us there.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: Alright, if you say so.

steps.name: Bill
steps.text: As for you lot. Don't even think about pulling any funny moves. We are watching you, Sarkaz.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Uhh... Amiya, I feel a little unwelcome. Like, I've never felt this unwelcomed.

options: It'll be hard for us to work together.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Sorry. They aren't usually like this. It's just, they're a little sensitive... about how some of you look.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Things will be much better once our commander talks some sense into them. Come with me. They're having a meeting up ahead.

steps.name: Angry Young Male Voice
steps.text: Did you not hear that? They blew the port up with the defensive cannons! We can't stay here any longer! It's too risky!

steps.name: Calm Middle-aged Female Voice
steps.text: But if we leave Sudean, it won't be easy for us to come back to help the people here.

steps.name: Angry Young Male Voice
steps.text: I want to help them too. You think I don't want to? But do you know where our people are locked up? Are our men supposed to search house by house in front of the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Calm Middle-aged Female Voice
steps.text: Feist and Rockrock have been searching for information.

steps.name: Angry Young Male Voice
steps.text: They're too slow! The situation has changed. The Sarkaz could blow this hideout to smithereens any moment! All our hard work, gone!

steps.name: Calm Middle-aged Female Voice
steps.text: The hideout is dead. Those people are alive.

steps.name: Angry Young Male Voice
steps.text: That's awfully easy for you to say! It's not like it was you business folks who built this place from scratch, bit by bit!

options: Seems like they're in a bit of a row.
Did we come at a bad time?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Haha, just a minor squabble.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Don't worry. The commander won't mind.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Most folks here come from very different backgrounds. They may not agree with each other sometimes, but all of us stand together.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Besides, no matter how out of hand their feud gets, as long as the commander is here, we'll find a solution in the end.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Hm... She rescued most of us. If it wasn't for our commander, we would long have died by the hands of the Sarkaz or Dublinn.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Just like Rockrock. Her pa was beaten to death by the mercenaries because he wasn't willing to sell the defense force out.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: As for me, I didn't want to work for the Sarkaz, so me and a few coworkers ran all the way here from Highbury. We almost died of hunger in the tunnels...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: In the end, it was the commander who found us.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: She was the one who pulled each of us up from our hopelessness and united us.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: All of us look up to her, and we trust that she will lead us through each and every hopeless situation we'll come across.

steps.name: Angry Young Male Voice
steps.text: Commander, help me out. We should get out of here right now, right?

steps.name: Calm Middle-aged Female Voice
steps.text: Commander, I suggest we start a rescue operation right away.

steps.name: Some seven and eight other voices.
steps.text: Commander...

steps.name: Young-sounding Voice
steps.text: Harmo, Tyrell. Calm down, both of you.

steps.name: Young-sounding Voice
steps.text: Time is of the essence. This is no time for infighting.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That voice...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina, what's the matter?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No, nothing. I might just have misheard.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mr. Feist, is the one who last spoke your commander? She sounds... very young.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Surprising, isn't it? When I first met her, I thought the exact same thing.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Do you remember how I figured out you were the leader the moment I first saw you, Cautus lady? Soon, you'll know how I knew.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Come, let's meet our commander.

steps.name: Young-sounding Voice
steps.text: I know how you feel, everyone, but there is one point that I think requires no discussion.

steps.name: Young-sounding Voice
steps.text: We will save our brothers and sisters in arms.

steps.name: Young-sounding Voice
steps.text: If we let our enemies hurt our warriors, who would be willing to fight alongside us?

steps.name: Young-sounding Voice
steps.text: If we let our enemies take our friends away, who would be willing to offer us a helping hand?

steps.name: Young-sounding Voice
steps.text: We are the Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps. We must save Londinium, but before that, we need to save each and every one of our living friends.
Her hands are slender and delicate. Fragile, even. Yet it seems to have enough power to quell the anger and anxiety that is about to boil over.
The meeting room falls into silence.
Those in attendance naturally cast their eyes on their commander. It is as though none of them have ever doubted whether her narrow shoulders could bear their heavy hope.
The scene is somewhat familiar.
Most of the Rhodes Island Operators feel this way. They all turn their gazes toward the Cautus who stands in front of them.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I think I know what Feist means now.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Ehhh, they really are kinda alike, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone... quiet down. Let's not interrupt their meeting.

steps.name: Young-sounding Voice
steps.text: Looks like we have a few new friends to greet before we discuss a concrete rescue plan.

steps.name: Young-sounding Voice
steps.text: Feist, bring them here.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Uh... Yes, Commander!

steps.name: Young-sounding Voice
steps.text: Well met, Rhodes Island. I've been looking forward to your arrival.

steps.name: Young-sounding Voice
steps.text: I'm Clovisia, the commander of the Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General, the commander of Dublinn is here.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Madam Mandragora.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: General... Manfred.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I trust you are here because you have something important to discuss.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You... Hmph, you saw everything, and you still put up this act?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Are you really a Sarkaz? They don't seem to be so...

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Tricky, like you.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Madam Mandragora, your words just now could be taken as an insult to the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Whatever you say.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: I'm here... to apologize anyway.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Oh? You have an apology?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: My men had a little misunderstanding with your people down at the port.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Misunderstanding?

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: I... I'm here because I wanted to make sure... the cooperation between us still stands.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Madam, let me remind you again. There are no concrete terms that we must follow for our cooperation to continue.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Dublinn will not interfere with Sarkaz operations in Londinium. In exchange, we will allow you to remain in a demarcated area here.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You can take that as a..

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Tacit understanding, between the two of us.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: You told me, yes... and I haven't forgotten.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Right, and it doesn't matter if you have. We will consider the ruckus earlier a reminder.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Thank... you.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Don't be so quick to thank me. The Sarkaz are not as forgetful as you.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: What do you want me to do, then? Do you want my life? If that's what you really want...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: If that's what I actually wanted, you would not have made it here.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Hmm... and you wouldn't have taken to the steps of Westhaleg those months ago, either.

steps.name: Mandragora
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: What we want to see is a bit of sincerity from Dublinn.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: And not the kind of 'sincerity' where you snatch a few Victorian soldiers from us or kidnap a couple Londinium citizens who escaped.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: It's about time that... we actually cooperate.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Horn!

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: I didn't want to bother you, but Salley... he's not going to last much longer! His leg is so swollen that you can't even squeeze any more pus out...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Is the 3rd back yet?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: No, things were a mess outside this morning. It might have delayed things for them.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: How many men do we have?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: Including the new blood, we have a total of seventeen who can fight.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: The 2nd will stay. High alert.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: I'll bring five men with me and pay the Dublinn's borrowed home a little visit.

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: But... if you go back, what will you do if you run into Mandragora again?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Salley can't wait much longer.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: He needs medicine. Without painkillers and anti-inflammatories, he won't even make it through the afternoon.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Do any of you have anything that's worth money? Hm? Old Ayton's been racking his brains just to figure out how to trade for enough food each day.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: If we don't take it from Dublinn, who are we supposed to turn to? The Sarkaz?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Or do you mean to ask the civilians for help? Have you given it any thought what the enemy will do to them if they offer us anything?

steps.name: Victorian Soldier
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Dejection won't buy us our friend's life.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Pack it up. Bring any weapons we can use. We'll leave immediately.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Robben, you said you haven't killed enough of them, right? Lucky you. Your chance is here.
